quicksteps_calendar_event_hint: Creates an event on your connected calendar before the detected deadline.
quicksteps_apply_label_hint: The label is added to the email. A category label (Action, Info, Noise) replaces the category; others stack alongside.
quicksteps_snoozed_draft_body_placeholde:
Hi {{recipient_name}},

Just wanted to follow up on my last email. Let me know if you need anything from my side.
quicksteps_snoozed_draft_var_first_name_: Inserts the recipient's first name only
quicksteps_snoozed_draft_explainer_step1: creates a follow-up draft and tucks it into Later.
quicksteps_snoozed_draft_explainer_step2: checks whether the recipient replied to your original email.
quicksteps_snoozed_draft_explainer_step3: Reply found → draft deleted. No reply → the original thread comes back to your inbox top with the 🔁 Follow-up chip, and the pre-loaded draft appears in Drafts (🔁 + ⚡ Auto badges).
quicksteps_fires_on_locked_sent: Locked to "sent" — this rule contains a follow-up action.
quicksteps_trigger_is_new_thread_sent: Sent emails in a new thread
quicksteps_trigger_hint_thread_has_user_: Matches once you've replied to this email (a message you sent after it arrived — starting the thread doesn't count). Combine with the Archive action to recreate "auto-archive after reply".
quicksteps_trigger_hint_previously_auto_: Matches when the selected quick action has already auto-fired on an email in this thread. Lets a rule react to its own past decisions (e.g. auto-archived, then a reply lands → un-archive).
quicksteps_trigger_hint_calendar_invite_: Matches only when both your calendar and your focus / deep-work blocks are free during the slot the invite proposes — ideal for auto-accepting when you're truly available.
quicksteps_trigger_hint_matches: Regex pattern (case-insensitive), searched anywhere in the field. e.g. noreply|no-reply catches both variants.
quicksteps_trigger_hint_recipient_is: Matches when the text is exactly one of the To / Cc addresses.
quicksteps_validation_triggers_required: Add at least one condition for auto-trigger.
quicksteps_recipe_noise_desc: Move every email labelled "noise" to spam. Auto-trigger.
quicksteps_recipe_vip_desc: Pin and mark unread emails from a VIP domain. Auto-trigger.
quicksteps_recipe_rsvp_desc: Reply YES to an invitation, then archive the email.
quicksteps_confirm_delete_msg_named: "{{name}}" will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
quicksteps_confirm_delete_msg: This quick action will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
quicksteps_mark_emoji_text_hint: Shown next to the emoji on the inbox row (max 24 chars).

quicksteps_mark_emoji_include_deadline: Merge the auto-detected deadline into this chip

quicksteps_seeded_archive_info_emails_on: Once you've read a message labelled Info, archive it automatically — keeps the inbox to actionable items only.
quicksteps_seeded_accept_meeting_invitat: Auto-accept calendar invites when you're free at that time slot — the response goes out as soon as the invite lands, no back-and-forth.
quicksteps_seeded_reply_forward_and_arch: Triggers on invoice emails — fires a templated reply, forwards a copy to your ops address (edit the recipient below before enabling), then archives the original.
